svg.title: What the network believes, frame by frame, as training goes on: "two wow learn"
svg.desc: Five heatmaps of per-frame class probabilities for one validation utterance, at training steps 0, 100, 300, 1000 and the end. Early on everything is smeared; then the blank takes over; then sharp spikes appear for each letter in order.
svg.text: What the network believes, frame by frame, as training goes on: "two wow learn"
STEP 0: UNTRAINED, EVERY FRAME A VAGUE GUESS
STEP 100: IT HAS LEARNED ONE THING, TO SAY BLANK EVERYWHERE
STEP 300: THE FIRST LETTERS POKE THROUGH
STEP 1,000: MOST LETTERS ARE THERE, SOME STILL UNSURE
STEP 40,000, THE FINISHED MODEL: SHORT SPIKES FOR THE LETTERS, BLANK IN BETWEEN
